title: Model-specific runtime optimizations: Llama / Mistral / Qwen (GQA/MQA tuning, kernels, scheduling, KV cache, continuous batching)
author: Priya Narayanan
description: Motivation: Several production regressions and microbenchmarks showed model-specific performance quirks for Llama, Mistral and Qwen families when using group-quantized (GQA) and mixed-quantized (MQA) variants. This PR implements targeted runtime adjustments to improve throughput and tail latency while preserving correctness across quantized and non-quantized builds. Approach: 1) Kernel selector heuristics: extend the runtime kernel selector to prefer small-seq optimized GEMM kernels for Mistral and Llama 7B-class variants at sequence lengths <= 128, and prefer vectorized attention kernels for Qwen 7/14b when MQA is detected. 2) GQA/MQA tuning: add detection logic for group-quantized layouts at model load and apply per-model scaling factors and dequant reorder paths that avoid cheap-but-wrong fused kernels. 3) Scheduler adjustments: introduce per-model scheduling profiles that bias early-token prefilling to reduce KV cache pressure for Mistral workloads with many short-turn interactions. 4) KV cache improvements: add a hot-page eviction policy to reduce memory churn for multi-stream KV cache access patterns, and fix a race in the cache resize path that could degrade throughput under bursty traffic. 5) Continuous batching heuristics: adapt batch delay timers and max-batch-size caps per model family to better trade latency vs throughput for common production distributions. Changes also include tests and benchmark harness updates. Benchmarks: internal perf lab (A100/80GB, steady-state inference): Llama-2-7B (GQA) throughput +18% at seq=128, p99 latency -12%. Mistral-7B (MQA edge-case tuning) throughput +12% at seq=64, p95 latency -10%. Qwen-14B (mixed quant path) throughput +22% for batched workloads with long context. Rollout plan: gated canary on dedicated clusters, A/B rollout with automatic fallback to previous kernel selector on regression detection. Checklist: [x] unit and integration tests [x] perf benchmarks added [x] canary rollout docs [x] release notes

Priya Narayanan: Added stress test and linked to perf job that caught the original issue

release_notes: Model-specific runtime optimizations for Llama/Mistral/Qwen: improved kernel selection for small-sequence workloads, GQA/MQA detection and optimized dequant paths, per-model scheduling profiles, KV cache hot-page eviction and race fix, and continuous batching heuristics. Expected impact: 10-25% throughput improvement and 8-15% tail latency reduction on quantized/deployed workloads. Shipped as a canary rollout on Dedicated; automatic rollback enabled on regression detection.
